secrets.name: JWT_SECRET
secrets.description: Signs and verifies the API's JWT access tokens. A development value is generated for the sandbox; review before any real deployment.

secrets.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe secret key (Stripe dashboard > Developers > API keys, sk_test_...). The API needs a non-empty value to boot; a committed development placeholder keeps the app running, but payment intents, refunds and webhooks stay non-functional until the real key is provided.

secrets.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Stripe webhook signing secret (Stripe dashboard > Developers > Webhooks, whsec_...). Only needed to verify /api/v1/payments/webhook calls.

secrets.name: CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME
secrets.description: Cloudinary cloud name (Cloudinary console > Dashboard). Needed for profile image uploads.

secrets.name: CLOUDINARY_API_KEY
secrets.description: Cloudinary API key (Cloudinary console > Dashboard). Needed for profile image uploads.

secrets.name: CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET
secrets.description: Cloudinary API secret (Cloudinary console > Dashboard). Needed for profile image uploads.

secrets.name: SMTP_HOST
secrets.description: Outgoing mail server hostname (for example smtp.gmail.com or a transactional provider such as SendGrid/Mailgun). Needed for notification emails.

secrets.name: SMTP_PORT
secrets.description: Outgoing mail server port (587 for STARTTLS). Needed for notification emails.

secrets.name: SMTP_USER
secrets.description: SMTP username / sender address used for notification emails.

secrets.name: SMTP_PASS
secrets.description: SMTP password or provider API key used for notification emails.

secrets.name: VITE_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe publishable key (Stripe dashboard > Developers > API keys, pk_test_...). Public by design; the browser needs it to render the Stripe payment element.
